name: International Center on Nonviolent Conflict
geography: United States (Washington, DC), with international programming

observed_activities.text: Publishes the ICNC Monograph and Special Report series on civil resistance movements and curricula for educators.
Convenes academic workshops and online courses on the history and dynamics of civil resistance.

public_positions.text: Describes itself as a private, independent foundation supporting the study and discussion of civil resistance.
